acceptable.description: Raw email address is included in the error message and may end up in logs.

must_not_flag.description: Claim that the pattern rejects uppercase letters. It does not, and the input is lowercased first anyway.
Demanding full RFC 5322 validation. A pragmatic pattern is a reasonable choice for a value object.
Tests are included in the change.

notes: This sample checks restraint. A good run keeps at most one low-severity finding and says clearly that the change looks good.
